test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

He said, “I will go to Indonesia tomorrow”.

options.text: He said that he would go to Indonesia tomorrow.
He said that he would go to Indonesia the next day.
He said that he would be going to Indonesia the next day.
He said he would go to Indonesia by tomorrow.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **When converting** direct speech into indirect or reported speech, certain rules need to be followed.
 
• For instance, **verb tenses** usually **shift back** in reported speech.
 
• The present tense** becomes **the past tense, future tense **changes** to conditional tense.
 
• **He said that he would go to Indonesia the next day: **This option** correctly converts **"will go" to "would go" and "tomorrow" to "the next day". 
 
• It is a **correct transformation **of the direct speech into indirect speech.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'He said that he would go to Indonesia the next day.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Given this, let's analyze the options:
 
 
• **He said that he would go to Indonesia tomorrow: **This option **incorrectly** retains "tomorrow". In **reported speech,** "tomorrow" should become** "the next day".**
 
• **He said that he would be going to Indonesia the next day:** While this sentence is grammatically correct, it is a slightly more elaborate way of expressing the future in the past. The simpler form ("would go") is usually preferred.
 
• **He said he would go to Indonesia by tomorrow:** This option changes the meaning of the original sentence. "By tomorrow" implies he will go sometime before or at the designated time (tomorrow), which is not what the original sentence says.
